label: BA

notes.grounding: Claims about the script match it: fixed final exit 0, existing exit 1 usage-error convention with 'Use --help for usage information', OVERALL_PERCENTAGE in folder mode vs the sourced per-file percentage in --file mode, the set -euo pipefail hazard comment in calculate_spec_completeness, bc dependency, TMPDIR stats dir with EXIT trap, option list. No line numbers are cited, so none can be wrong. One external claim (the spec-script exit-3 taxonomy) cannot be confirmed from the script itself.
notes.requirements: REQ-001..007 are testable and cover exit 3 below N, exit 0 at or above N (boundary explicit), byte-identical output, and missing/non-integer/out-of-range values exiting 1 with no report. Gap: no requirement for --file on a missing file (the script prints NOT FOUND and percentage is undefined), so the gate's status there is unspecified.
notes.verification: Phase 3 tasks name concrete checks (bash -n, diff against baselines, boundary statuses, invalid values, validate.sh --strict with RESULT: PASSED), but no task carries a 'Verify:' clause, and implementation tasks T001-T009 have no verification attached. Checks mostly describe intent rather than a literal command and expected output (T012/T013 never name the fixture command or the observed percentage).
notes.scope: Stays on one option in one file at Level 1, explicit out-of-scope list, no invented subsystems, no unfilled tokens or filler sections.
notes.consistency: Ids, file path, exit codes 0/1/3 and the help-text contract agree across all three docs. Minor drift: plan says 'four edits to a single file' while tasks.md lists five implementation tasks (T005-T009); REQ-004's parity diff lists default/--verbose/--json while plan and T011 add --file.
notes.clarity: A developer could implement it: global default empty, case arm with shift 2, validation message text given, post-output gate inside an if block. Open points: gate behavior when --file points at a missing file, and how fixtures with a 'known low percentage' are built.
